arxiv-1606-08791.title: Phase diagram and self-organising dynamics in a strongly-interacting thermal Rydberg ensemble
arxiv-1606-08791.creator: Dong-Sheng Ding, Hannes Busche, Bao-Sen Shi, Guang-Can Guo, Charles S. Adams
arxiv-1606-08791.description: Abstract Far-from equilibrium dynamics that lead to self-organization are highly relevant to complex dynamical systems not only in physics, but also in life-, earth-, and social sciences. It is challenging however to find systems with sufficiently controllable parameters that allow quantitatively modelling of emergent properties.

arxiv-2204-12166.title: Probing the extragalactic mid-infrared background with HAWC
arxiv-2204-12166.creator: A. Albert, R. Alfaro, C. Alvarez, J.C. Arteaga-Velázquez, D. Avila Rojas, H.A. Ayala Solares, R. Babu, E. Belmont-Moreno, K.S. Caballero-Mora, T. Capistrán, A. Carramiñana, S. Casanova, O. Chaparro-Amaro, U. Cotti, J. Cotzomi, S. Coutiño de León, E. De la Fuente, R. Diaz Hernandez, M.A. DuVernois, M
arxiv-2204-12166.description: Abstract The extragalactic background light (EBL) contains all the radiation emitted by nuclear and accretion processes in stars and compact objects since the epoch of recombination. Measuring the EBL density directly is challenging, especially in the near- to far-infrared waveband, mainly due to the zodiacal light foreground.

arxiv-2205-02276.title: Iterated line graphs with only negative eigenvalues − 2 -2 , their complements and energy
arxiv-2205-02276.creator: Harishchandra S. Ramane, B. Parvathalu, K. Ashoka, Daneshwari Patil
arxiv-2205-02276.description: Abstract The graphs with all equal negative or positive eigenvalues are special kind in the spectral graph theory. In this article, several iterated line graphs ℒ k ​ ( G ) \mathcal{L}^{k}(G) with all equal negative eigenvalues − 2 -2 are characterized for k ≥ 1 k\geq 1 and their energy consequences are presented.

arxiv-2210-06911.title: Single- and Multimagnon Dynamics in Antiferromagnetic α \alpha -Fe 2 O 3 Thin Films
arxiv-2210-06911.creator: Jiemin Li, Yanhong Gu, Yoshihiro Takahashi, Keisuke Higashi, Taehun Kim, Yang Cheng, Fengyuan Yang, Jan Kuneš, Jonathan Pelliciari, Atsushi Hariki, Valentina Bisogni
arxiv-2210-06911.description: Abstract Understanding the spin dynamics in antiferromagnetic (AFM) thin films is fundamental for designing novel devices based on AFM magnon transport. Here, we study the magnon dynamics in thin films of AFM S = 5 2 S=\frac{5}{2} α \alpha -Fe 2 O 3 by combining resonant inelastic x-ray scattering, Anderson impurity model plus dynamical mean-field theory, and Heisenberg spin model.

arxiv-2302-04816.title: Optimal Semiclassical Regularity of Projection Operators and Strong Weyl Law
arxiv-2302-04816.creator: Laurent Lafleche
arxiv-2302-04816.description: Abstract . Projection operators arise naturally as one-particle density operators associated to Slater determinants in fields such as quantum mechanics and the study of determinantal processes. In the context of the semiclassical approximation of quantum mechanics, projection operators can be seen as the analogue of characteristic functions of subsets of the phase space, which are discontinuous functions.

arxiv-2307-02598.title: Additive Decoders for Latent Variables Identification and Cartesian-Product Extrapolation
arxiv-2307-02598.creator: Sébastien Lachapelle, Divyat Mahajan, Ioannis Mitliagkas, Simon Lacoste-JulienMila & DIRO, Université de Montréal
arxiv-2307-02598.description: Abstract We tackle the problems of latent variables identification and “out-of-support” image generation in representation learning. We show that both are possible for a class of decoders that we call additive , which are reminiscent of decoders used for object-centric representation learning (OCRL) and well suited for images that can be decomposed as a sum of object-specific images.

arxiv-2311-14578.title: Criticality-Enhanced Precision in Phase Thermometry
arxiv-2311-14578.creator: Mei Yu, H. Chau Nguyen, Stefan Nimmrichter
arxiv-2311-14578.description: Abstract Temperature estimation of interacting quantum many-body systems is both a challenging task and topic of interest in quantum metrology, given that critical behavior at phase transitions can boost the metrological sensitivity. Here we study non-invasive quantum thermometry of a finite, two-dimensional Ising spin lattice based on measuring the non-Markovian dephasing dynamics of a spin probe coupled to the lattice.

arxiv-2403-03198.title: Surface and sub-surface modifications of copper electrodes exposed to electric high-field conditioning at cryogenic temperatures.
arxiv-2403-03198.creator: Marek Jacewicz, Iaroslava Profatilova, Yinon Ashkenazy, Sergio Calatroni, Inna Popov, Piotr Szaniawski, Walter Wuensch
arxiv-2403-03198.description: Abstract It has been stipulated that the conditioning of metal surfaces under a high electric field is dominated by material hardening. To test this, we subjected three pairs of copper electrodes to high-voltage conditioning at distinct temperatures (300 K, 30 K, and 10 K) until each reached its saturation field.

arxiv-2403-08199.title: Deep Submodular Peripteral Networks
arxiv-2403-08199.creator: Gantavya Bhatt Arnav M. Das Jeffrey A. BilmesUniversity of Washington, Seattle, WA 98195 {gbhatt2, arnavmd2, bilmes}@uw.edu
arxiv-2403-08199.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Gantavya Bhatt Arnav M. Das Jeffrey A. BilmesUniversity of Washington, Seattle, WA 98195 {gbhatt2, arnavmd2, bilmes}@uw.edu. Submodular functions, crucial for various applications, often lack practical learning methods for their acquisition. Seemingly unrelated, learning a scaling from oracles offering graded pairwise preferences (GPC) is underexplored, despite a rich history in psychometrics.

arxiv-2404-09762.title: Strong coupling electron-photon dynamics: a real-time investigation of energy redistribution in molecular polaritons
arxiv-2404-09762.creator: Matteo Castagnola, Marcus T. Lexander, Enrico Ronca, Henrik Koch
arxiv-2404-09762.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Matteo Castagnola, Marcus T. Lexander, Enrico Ronca, Henrik Koch. We analyze the real-time electron-photon dynamics in long-range polariton-mediated energy transfer using a real-time quantum electrodynamics coupled cluster (RT-QED-CC) model, which allows for spatial and temporal visualization of transport processes. We compute the time evolution of photonic and molecular observables, such as the dipole moment and the photon coordinate, following the excitation of the system induced by short laser pulses.

arxiv-2411-17684.title: RealSeal: Revolutionizing Media Authentication with Real-Time Realism Scoring Conference: INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON MULTIMODAL INTERACTION; November 4–8, 2024; San Jose, Costa Rica INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON MULTIMODAL INTERACTION (ICMI ’24), November 4–8, 2024, San Jose, Costa Rica DOI: 10.1145/
arxiv-2411-17684.creator: Bhaktipriya Radharapu, Harish Krishna
arxiv-2411-17684.description: Abstract . The growing threat of deepfakes and manipulated media necessitates a radical rethinking of media authentication. Existing methods for watermarking synthetic data fall short, as they can be easily removed or altered, and current deepfake detection algorithms do not achieve perfect accuracy.

arxiv-2412-05730.title: Multivector (MV) functions in Clifford algebras of arbitrary dimension: Defective MV case
arxiv-2412-05730.creator: A. Acus*, A. Dargys, A. Acus, A. Dargys
arxiv-2412-05730.description: Abstract Explicit formulas to calculate MV functions in a basis-free representation are presented for an arbitrary Clifford geometric algebra 𝐶𝑙 p , q \mathit{Cl}_{p,q} . The formulas are based on analysis of the roots of minimal MV polynomial and covers defective MVs, i.e. the MVs that have non-diagonalizable matrix representations.

arxiv-2502-08542.title: Beyond Predictions: A Participatory Framework for Multi-Stakeholder Decision-Making Thanks: A preliminary version of this paper was accepted to MODeM @ @ ECAI’25. Corresponding authors’ email vineis@diag.uniroma1.it. © 2025 Copyright held by the authors. ArXiv preprint.
arxiv-2502-08542.creator: Vittoria Vineis, Giuseppe Perelli, Gabriele Tolomei
arxiv-2502-08542.description: Abstract . Conventional automated decision-support systems often prioritize predictive accuracy, overlooking the complexities of real-world settings where stakeholders’ preferences may diverge or conflict. This can lead to outcomes that disadvantage vulnerable groups and erode trust in algorithmic processes. Participatory AI approaches aim to address these issues but remain largely context-specific, limiting their broader applicability and scalability.

pmc-11604924.title: The expression profile analysis and functional prediction of lncRNAs in peripheral blood mononuclear cells in maintenance hemodialysis patients developing heart failure
pmc-11604924.creator: Xing Qi, Lin Yu, Shuai Liu, Yujiao Zhou, Wenqing Liu, Wei Liao, Qin Guo, Xuhui Song, Jifeng Li, Sheng Lin, Chuanqiang Dai, Lin Yan, Tao Li, Li Zhang, Shucheng Zhao, Juan Tang, Jian Cai, Zejiang Liu, Ran Zhu, Q-Y Long, Huaguo Wang
pmc-11604924.description: Heart failure (HF) is the leading cause of death in patients with maintenance hemodialysis (MHD). Biomarkers has an important guiding role in the early diagnosis, risk stratification, and prognostic assessment of HF. Increasing studies have indicated that long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) have played an indispensable role in the regulatory network of HF.

pmc-11616123.title: Biofilm and the effect of sonication in a chronic Staphylococcus epidermidis orthopedic in vivo implant infection model
pmc-11616123.creator: Erik Thorvaldsen Sandbakken, Erling Høyer, Eivind Witsø, Caroline Krogh Søgaard, Alberto Díez-Sánchez, Linh Hoang, Tina Strømdal Wik, Kåre Bergh
pmc-11616123.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundIn diagnosing chronic orthopedic implant infections culture of sonicate represents a supplement to tissue cultures. However, the extent to which biofilm forms on implant surfaces and the degree of dislodgement of bacteria by sonication remains unclear.

pmc-12531456.title: Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor in Health and Disease
pmc-12531456.creator: Haonan Li, Yufeng Fan, Jizheng Liu, Shumin Dong, Bin Wen, Yunfei Zhang, Xiaocui Wang, Xuemei Duan, Ying Hu, Ze Yan, Huifeng Shang, Yukai Jing
pmc-12531456.description: The aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) functions as a ligand‐dependent transcription factor, serving as a pivotal environmental sensor that significantly influences both physiological and pathological processes. The inactivated state of AhR is present in the cell cytoplasm and transfer into the nucleus upon activation by a variety of ligands.

pmc-12703815.title: Training in metataxonomics‐integrated risk assessment for foodborne pathogens in the Polish and Spanish dairy chain (DAIRYPOL)
pmc-12703815.creator: Joanna Bucka‐Kolendo, Pablo S Fernández, Enriqueta Garcia‐Gutierrez
pmc-12703815.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Food safety is a key concern in the European Union, with the harmonisation of risk assessment methodologies being a strategic priority. The EU‐FORA programme, coordinated by EFSA, promotes standardised approaches to microbial risk assessment across Europe. Metagenomic sequencing has advanced the understanding of microbial ecosystems in food production, with Illumina (short‐reads) and Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) (long‐reads) playing significant roles in detecting pathogens and characterising microbial communities.

pmc-12985284.title: Sex-Dependent Metabolic Alterations in Red Blood Cells During COVID-19
pmc-12985284.creator: José Raul Herance, Idoia Álvarez-Ajuria, Carolina Aparicio-Gómez, Marina Giralt-Arnaiz, Celia Moya-Latorre, Rita Ortega-Vallbona, Martina Palomino-Schätzlein
pmc-12985284.description: Simple SummaryAlthough it is well known that COVID-19 affects red blood cells, the specific metabolic alterations and their relationship to disease outcome have not been fully explored. This study aimed to investigate how COVID-19 alters red blood cell metabolism and whether these changes differ according to sex, disease severity, and major risk factors.

pmc-13027538.title: Impact of Procalcitonin Kinetics on Mortality in Intensive Care Patients with Sepsis
pmc-13027538.creator: Yakup Özgüngör, Burak Emre Gilik, Emre Karagöz, Hicret Yeniay, Mensure Çakırgöz, Özlem Melis Korkmaz Özgüngör, İhsan Birol, Sıla Seven
pmc-13027538.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and Objectives: Procalcitonin (PCT) kinetics are increasingly used as prognostic markers in sepsis, but their interpretation is confounded by dynamic changes in renal function during acute illness. This study evaluated the prognostic value of ΔPCT for 30-day mortality in critically ill patients with either sepsis or septic shock by incorporating serial kinetic eGFR measurements and renal function-adjusted ΔPCT cut-off values based on the mean kinetic eGFR during the first 48–72 h of ICU admission.
